evidence_scope: First-party QCC 2026–27 degree map, clinical Nursing application, and general admissions; dated evidence only, not live seat, exam-registration, repeat, license, or individual eligibility advice.

degree_map.nu101_repeat: Repeat of NU-101 requires Nursing Department Appeals Committee approval; one nursing course may be repeated.

clinical_application.nu101_repeat: Unable to repeat NU-101 after withdrawal or grade below C.

nu101_repeat.public_guidance: QCC's 2026–27 degree map describes committee approval for repeating NU-101, while its clinical application page says repetition is unavailable after withdrawal or a grade below C. Confirm directly with Nursing; do not promise an appeal outcome.

entrance_exam.public_guidance: Current clinical application instructions require NEX, but the 2026–27 degree map mentions RN PAX. Confirm with Nursing before purchasing or scheduling either exam.

limitations: 2026–27 degree map corroborates a named A.A.S. curriculum, not current clinical seats or individualized admission.
General college Spring 2027 deadlines are NOT clinical Nursing deadlines; the announced October 5–16 clinical window elapsed.
No authority adjudicates the contradictory NU-101 repeat rules or exam labels in these sources.
A CIP classification is not a school-specific credential, RN/LPN license or automatic BSN.
NEX/RN PAX are clinical nursing-entry exams; neither determines SAT/ACT policy.
No claim of individual NCLEX-RN or state licensure eligibility.
